# Cloudflare Gotchas

> Known Cloudflare Workers and Pages patterns that cause deployment failures or unexpected behavior. Load all HIGH entries before deploying to Cloudflare.

## Entries

- [Hyperdrive proxy URLs are request-scoped -- never cache postgres connections](hyperdrive-connection-caching.md): Module-scope cached DB connections point to dead Hyperdrive proxy endpoints on subsequent requests, causing 500s. Create fresh connections per request. HIGH.
- [postgres.js max_lifetime creates stale connections with module-scope caching](postgres-max-lifetime-workers.md): max_lifetime: 1 tears down the connection but the cached instance is still reused. Combined with module-scope caching, subsequent requests get dead connections. HIGH.
- [@cloudflare/vite-plugin builds a Worker, not a Pages project](vite-plugin-worker-deploy.md): Deploy with `wrangler deploy` from `build/server/`, not `wrangler pages deploy build/client/`. Using Pages deploy gives static-only site with no SSR. MEDIUM.
- [postgres.js with fetch_types:false returns JSONB as strings](postgres-jsonb-as-strings.md): With fetch_types:false (required for Hyperdrive), JSONB columns arrive as raw strings, not objects. Use a parseRow() helper with typeof check. MEDIUM.
- [Unapplied migration files cause silent column-missing failures](unapplied-migration-silent-failure.md): Migration file in repo but never run against production. INSERTs fail with confusing "column does not exist" errors. Always verify migrations were applied. HIGH.
- ["Block AI bots" silently 403s your own MCP / OAuth connector](block-ai-bots-breaks-mcp-connector.md): Cloudflare's "Block AI bots" feature 403s Anthropic/OpenAI connector user-agents (ClaudeBot, Claude-User, GPTBot) at the edge, so a self-hosted MCP/OAuth server's connector fails with no server-side log; OAuth runs under the browser UA so it looks like a code bug. Diagnose by curling with a Claude UA; fix is Cloudflare config (disable AI-bot block or WAF-skip the API paths). HIGH.
- [cloudflared upgrade leaves the Windows service Stopped](cloudflared-upgrade-leaves-service-stopped.md): A winget/self-upgrade of cloudflared gracefully stops the `Cloudflared` service to swap the binary and never restarts it; graceful stop (SCM 7036) bypasses sc recovery actions (fire only on 7031) and Automatic-start-at-boot, so the tunnel stays silently down until reboot/manual start. Fix = Start-Service; monitor at the RMM layer. HIGH.
- [Proxying a DNS-only record activates every Cloudflare-layer feature on that host](dns-only-to-proxied-activates-features.md): Flipping grey-cloud to orange-cloud (e.g. to reach a Tunnel) suddenly runs all previously-bypassed Workers/redirect/WAF/Access rules on that host; a `*/*` Worker hijacked api./control. at cutover with no origin log. Audit edge features before proxying. HIGH.
- [Public hostname routes are account-wide, not device-profile-scoped](public-hostname-routes-account-wide.md): A Tunnel public hostname route applies to every WARP client in the account; the pilot device profile scopes nothing about it. Blast radius is decided by whether a profile's Split Tunnel excludes `100.64.0.0/10`, and an emptied default exclude list silently takes the whole fleet. Routing only an IdP endpoint breaks multi-hop app sign-ins (Azure DevOps) into an infinite redirect loop while sign-in logs report 100% success. HIGH.
- [Workers Builds cannot be created via POST /builds/workers -- use connections + triggers](workers-builds-create-via-triggers.md): The documented "Create worker build configuration" endpoint rejects every payload with a detail-free `12002: Invalid request body`, including Cloudflare's own example. Real path is `PUT /builds/repos/connections` then `POST /builds/triggers` (with the script *tag*, not name), and build env vars are a separate PATCH. MEDIUM.
- [Transferring a repo between GitHub orgs silently stops Workers Builds](workers-builds-org-transfer-stops-deploys.md): A transfer changes the owner id the connection pins (`provider_account_id`) while leaving `repo_id` intact, so push events stop arriving with no failed build, no queued build and no error anywhere -- and GitHub's redirect keeps `git push` succeeding, which hides it. A rename is harmless; compare owner ids, not names. Probe with `config_autofill?branch=main` (200 vs `12000 Not found`), then `PUT /builds/repos/connections`, which updates in place so the connection UUID and every trigger survive. HIGH.

- [A Realtime TURN key's secret is returned once, at creation, and never again](turn-key-secret-returned-once.md): GET on the key returns uid/name/created and no secret, and there is no reveal endpoint -- a create call whose response you did not fully capture leaves a key you cannot authenticate with, and the field is named `secret` (not `key`/`token`), so a guard written from memory discards it silently. The endpoint also lives under /calls/, not /realtime/, and credentials are minted against rtc.live.cloudflare.com rather than api.cloudflare.com. MEDIUM.
